title: Tank Level Pump Hysteresis
source_reference: 经验改编：储液罐补液泵控制
requirements: Control a tank refill pump with hysteresis. When enable is TRUE and level is less than or equal to lowLevel, start and latch pumpRun. Keep it running until level is greater than or equal to highLevel. Disable stops the pump. Latch highHighAlarm when level is greater than or equal to 95.0. The alarm remains latched after the level falls and can be cleared only when alarmReset is TRUE and level is below 90.0. If lowLevel is greater than or equal to highLevel, set configError and force pumpRun FALSE.

creation_process: 根据液位开关控制经验整理补液泵滞回逻辑
human_modifications: 增加阈值合法性检查，并将高高报警改为带安全复位液位的锁存报警
review_process: 核对泵在低液位启动、高液位停止的物理方向
检查异常阈值时泵安全停止，并检查高高报警在液位降到 90% 以下且人工复位前保持锁存

plc_rationale: 液位滞回可避免泵在阈值附近频繁启停，配置检查和高高报警符合储罐现场控制需求。

notes: v3 增加高高报警锁存及低液位安全复位条件。
